title: Reminders and notifications
goal: Scheduled in-app reminders, acknowledgement and delivery preferences with explicit provider boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: A reminder can be scheduled/listed/acknowledged; due reminders become READY on read. Email/SMS remain preferences only until a provider is approved and configured.
prototypeBoundaries: In-memory stores reset on process restart.
Demo actor headers are not authentication.
Do not claim live external integrations or real opportunities unless verified.
